target_year_over_year_context.explanation:
Both disclosures report on 'Gains (Losses) on Equity Investments, Net'. D079 (2023) details fair value adjustments on sales of equity investments (portfolio companies). D094 (2024) details net gains on equity investments, primarily driven by gains from the sale of equity investments (Astera Labs). Both focus on realized gains/adjustments from sales rather than unrealized holding gains.

D079 (2023) covers Gains on Equity Investments. D095 (2024) covers Interest and Other, Net. These are distinct line items within the same broader section, but not the same topic.

comparisons.peer_topic: Other Income (Expense), Net Composition and Results
comparisons.peer_summary: Other income (expense), net totaled $181 million in 2024, down from $197 million in 2023, primarily due to decreased interest income from lower short-term investment balances; this line item is primarily comprised of interest income from short-term investments, changes in valuation of equity investments, and foreign currency transaction gains and losses.
comparisons.comparison: Intel reports a specific line item for 'Gains (Losses) on Equity Investments, Net' with a quantified $242 million gain driven by the Astera Labs sale. AMD groups 'changes in valuation of equity investments' into a broader 'Other income (expense), net' line item, which totaled $181 million. While both recognize gains/valuations from equity investments, Intel isolates the equity gain disclosure and highlights a realized sale event, whereas AMD treats it as a component of a mixed income/expense line dominated by interest income changes.

Other income (expense), net is primarily comprised of interest income from short-term investments, changes in valuation of equity investments and foreign currency transaction gains and losses.
Other income (expense), net was $181 million in 2024 compared to $197 million of Other income, net in 2023.
